report: Maiko, level 101 warlock, completed/rewarded 44663 and arrived on map 1220 in zone 7502 with no active quests. Walking near the Wowhead quest location played Lan'dalock's Spectral Sight conversation instead of offering The Sixth.
findings: SpellArea::IsFitToRequirements accepts only quest statuses included in quest_end_status. Spell 204860 had mask 74 (COMPLETE, INCOMPLETE, REWARDED), excluding NONE=0. Warlock class mask 256 and area 7502 were correct.

Native SpellEffect 302399 summons Ritssyn 103506 via spell 204860 and SummonProperties 3650; effect 344898 adds a dummy aura. Native duration index 5 is 300000 ms. Existing SmartAI makes the NPC personal/following, offers quest 40716 and despawns after acceptance or its timeout.

Event objects 136..140 use Smart source type 13. Their 17 quest/objective conditions incorrectly used SourceId 10. SmartScript::ProcessEvent looks up the actual source type and event ID + 1, so those guards were never applied.

Event object 139 at -795.929,4436.11,738.243 on map 1220 links kill credit 108041, conversation 2382 (Lan'dalock), and spell 216454. Its guards require active quest 42594 and completed objectives 107998,108001,108011. Maiko had none of these.

Ritssyn greeting group 0 referenced BroadcastText 105637 (Akazamzarak's coin solicitation). Effective local hotfix BroadcastText 106111 is the warlock invitation, voice 71324. Existing quest-accept action referenced missing text group 1; BroadcastText 104179 supplies the native Circle of Wills invitation, voice 63919. These text IDs are supplied by the local hotfix DB, not present in the sparse local BroadcastText.db2 export.
repairs: Change only the original 204860 area row mask from 74 to 1; new/abandoned warlocks may receive the offer, active/completed/rewarded ones do not.
Rebind the 17 existing quest/progress guards from SourceId 10 to 13, preserving their prerequisites and custom conditions already present at the correct key.
Replace only the erroneous greeting reference and add missing acceptance text without replacing existing custom group 1 text.
validation: Test-DalaranClassIntro.ps1 compiles the production common SpellArea predicate, QuestStatus enum and Player::SetQuestUpdate. Covers initial offer, duplicate aura prevention, acceptance cleanup, abandon/reoffer, completed/rewarded/failed states, other classes and other zones.

Test-DalaranClassIntroData.ps1 applies the actual migration twice on connection-local copies; verifies 17 guards resolve to actual Smart event scripts, no-quest/wrong-progress cases reject and correct active progress permits the reported trigger, text bindings, unrelated rows and custom replacements.
Migration applied to live world DB and registered with the updater; no character quest or inventory mutation. Runtime caches reload at next startup; server was stopped by the time of deployment.
scope_limit: Repairs the missing initial offer and unrelated dialogue, not certification of the whole warlock campaign. Accepting the quest is still required for a quest-log entry. Ritssyn's appearance, speech, personal visibility and acceptance need a client retest. The optional portal after acceptance and the subsequent ritual/artifact chain have not been repaired or verified in this batch.
